objective: Decide whether the exact agentkit 1.0.0 stable bundle is safe to register and publish as one selectively installable marketplace entry.

environment.runtime: python-3 repository validators plus official quick validator through isolated uv dependency

criteria.structure: official and repository validators pass against the exact stable hash
criteria.routing: agentkit remains explicit and direct specialist/team/Agentic OS requests remain non-triggers
criteria.behavior: three real workflows and public regression cases pass
criteria.scripts-tools: positive, drift, false-completion, synthetic-relabel, approval, contract and rollback paths pass
criteria.security-authority: donors remain read-only and no installation or activation occurs
criteria.coexistence: one catalog identity and one selective plugin exist without nested donor discovery
criteria.portability: Claude Code, Codex and Cursor package manifests contain the same stable skill
criteria.lifecycle: registry, catalog, maturity ledger, package hashes, rollback and release views agree
criteria.user-outcome: agentkit is available as a stable repository marketplace entry with limitations explicit

holdout_policy.exposure_rule: outside the distributed pack; rotate after material behavior change

execution_policy.side_effects: repository files and generated package staging only
execution_policy.cleanup: remove only generated temporary staging; retain prior Git release as rollback evidence
